hints.content:
The measure of an arc is equal to the measure of the [[☃ definition 1]] that intercepts it.

The arc measure of $\stackrel{\large{\frown}}{BC}$ is the measure of $\angle BDC$. We need to find the measure of  $\angle BDC$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.definition: A central angle is an angle whose vertex is on the center of the circle.

options.alt: A circle that is centered around Point D. Points A, B, and C all lie on circle D in a clockwise direction. The angle A D B is seven N plus twelve degrees. The angle B D C is six N degrees. The angles A D C is thirteen N minus sixteen degrees. Arc B C is highlighted to show that it is congruent to angle B D C. Arc A B C is a major arc.

hints.content:
The measures of the central angles in a circle add up to $360^\circ$. 

$\begin{align}
m\angle ADB+ m\angle BDC+ m\angle CDA&=360
\\\\
7n+12 + 6n+ 13n-16 &= 360
\\\\
26n-4 &= 360
\\\\
26n &= 364
\\\\
n &= 14
\end{align}$

We remember that we were trying find the measure of $\angle BDC$.  Let's substitute in our value for $n$.

$\begin{align}
m\angle BDC&= (6n)^\circ
\\\\
&=6(14)^\circ
\\\\
&=84^\circ
\end{align}$
